dedupe_keys.name: iutf dataset enabling cross border resource for analysing the impact of rainfall on urban transportation

description: IUTF Dataset: Enabling Cross-Border Resource for Analysing the Impact of Rainfall on Urban Transportation is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Xuhui Lin et al. Understanding the impact of extreme weather, particularly flooding, on urban transportation systems can inform efforts to improve city resilience and traffic management. However, research and policy development are often hampered by a lack of datasets that comprehensively integrate detailed traffic dynamics, high-resolution weather information, and road network topology across multiple diverse urban environments. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: Excel, Parquet, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 1284830205 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
